en: By the look of him, child or not, he is high-born: a Kin of Darkness... no, a noble of darkness.{w}It might be wise not to push him too far.{w}
note: Narration about Mirco after his threat (290). Pronoun avoided ('this one'). [JP] rendered 'a noble of darkness' (not in glossary; common phrase, not a name). Editorial: 'this one' twice read stiffly and unidiomatic for a person; Mirco is male (glossary), so 'him/he'.

en: "Eeeeek, these people are serious!?{w}Wh-wh-what do I do!?"{w}{p}"Help...{w}Help me, Uncle!!"{w}
Stern Demon
"Pathetic... Mirco!"{w}
"Uncle~!"{w}
note: The source ends with a music note (non-ASCII); '~' carries the delighted tone.

en: "Master!"{w}
note: [JP] = the master of the household (Dalisiamarte); used as 'the master' throughout this slice.

en: "Well, well..."{w}
"It has been far too long, my liege!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'my liege' (Zephal's address for Dalisiamarte).

en: "Grrr..."{w}
"Mirco.{w}You are the one who will someday inherit our House Lenzer.{w}How can you go on in such a disgraceful state?"{w}
note: Accuracy: [JP] is a rebuke (how will the heir manage in this state), not a demand for an explanation.

en: "I'm sorry..."{w}

"Hmph. Well, no matter.{w}...So it was you who dragged the name of my house through the mud."{w}{p}"I am loath to barge into a children's quarrel like some parent...{w}but I cannot simply let you go home."{w}{p}"Regrettably, you must die.{w}There is no need to lament.
In time, we shall hold all things in our grasp."{w}{p}"Even if you lived a little longer...{w}{p}{0E}"Even if you lived a little longer... {0F}it would change nothing."{w}
note: Kept the source's repeated line with {0E}...{0F} and the unclosed first quote exactly as the Japanese has them. [JP]: 'we' = his kind/house, kept vague as in source.

en: Dalisiamarte

note: [JP] = 'worthy rivals'. The closing address calls on both the party and Mirco; Mirco answers next row.

en: "Y-yes!"{w}

note: Editorial: 'the pride of your lives' was unidiomatic; [JP] = lifelong pride.

en: "To think the master himself would appear..."{w}
note: 'himself' is safe: Dalisiamarte is male per glossary (Mirco's uncle).

en:
"S-s-s-sis!?
Th-that just now... was that...!?"{w}
note: [JP] (Elpina for Gurtia) = 'Sis' throughout; not in the glossary, lead may want a fixed rendering. Editorial: 'W-was that just now' read as a question about time; reordered so 'that just now' is the referent, still trailing off for Gurtia's answer.

en: "Yes, that was the master."{w}

"Ahh... to think I could behold my liege
with my own eyes in such a backwater...{w}I shall sleep well tonight!!"{w}
"...Man, I dunno."{w}
note: [JP]: a deflated mutter, explained in 334/338.

en: "What is it, Zapper?"{w}

note: [JP] = Mirco; 'that kid' keeps the dismissive tone without a pronoun.

en: "So coooool~!{w}My uncle is so coooool~!"{w}
note: Mirco gushing to himself; music note dropped (non-ASCII).

en: "Yeah, that ain't happenin' anytime soon."{w}
"Now then, let us be going as well.{w}There is no reason to linger in a place like this."{w}
"Indeed."{w}
"See you later, then..."{w}
Mirco and the others left.{w}
Mirco's Voice
"Waaah!?"{w}
Zapper's Voice
"How many times do I gotta tell ya the same thing!!{w}Don't close your eyes when the enemy attacks!!"{w}
"Whoa-whoa-whoa!?"{w}
Zephal's Voice

"You will never defeat an enemy
just by squawking and wailing!!"{w}
"Eeeeek!?"{w}

"Damn you, Mirco!
Changin' up your scream ain't gonna cut it!!"{w}
note: Zapper mocks Mirco switching from 'Whoa' to 'Eek' (351/355).

en: "Sis, what's with them?"{w}
"Not even a hint of progress, is there?"{w}
"Perhaps the young master is better suited to his studies, hm..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'the young master' (Mirco).

en:
"It's not about which one he's good at,
it's about which one he's less hopeless at, right?"{w}
"Hmmm..."{w}
"Stoooop iiit!?"{w}

"You think 'stop' works on a battlefield!?
Zapper, attack more sharply!!{w}Master Mirco's weak point is his footing!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Master Mirco' (Zephal and Gurtia). [JP] read as footing/feet.

en:
"Oh, what are you doing, Zapper?
You're letting him slip away...{w}There, right there... Get him!!"{w}
note: Gurtia cheers Zapper on against Mirco; 'him' = Mirco.

en:
"GRAAAAAAH!{w}Mirco, you little punk,
you still haven't swung your sword even once!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'you little punk' here (Damn you in 357).

en:
"Hey, hey, who do you think'll snap first,
Zephal or Zapper?{w}My money's on Zapper!"{w}
"Then just wait a second, will you!{w}Give me time to raise my sword!!"{w}
note: Answers Zapper's 'haven't swung your sword once' (375).

en:
"Zephal, I'd say.{w}Any moment now he'll shout 'I am the Hell Master!'
and beat the stuffing out of Master Mirco."{w}
note: Glossary catchphrase; [JP] -> single quotes.

en: "Honestly, you two.{w}Zephal and Zapper have both honed their mental discipline.{w}Unless it's something really bad, they won't snap during practice."{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'really bad' so Elpina's echo in 393 lands. Editorial: 'trained their minds with discipline' was clunky ([JP]).

en:
"Knock it off already!!
I am the Hell Masterrrr!!"{w}
"Aieee!?"{w}
"Told you."{w}
"Ooh, you called it, Sis!{w}Mirco really must be that bad, huh!"{w}
note: Echoes Hess's [JP] (383). [JP] -> plain 'Mirco'.

en: "Zephal..."{w}
"...Hey, hold up, Zephal!{w}Don't you sense somethin'?"{w}

"Indeed.
This is... that lot from before.{w}Show yourselves!!"{w}
"Ah! It's you guys!?"{w}
"So what'll it be? Send Mirco in again?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'again this time' was redundant ([JP]).

en:
"I would like to, but any more disgrace
would tarnish the name of House Lenzer as well."{w}{p}"I think the two of us should join in this time."{w}

"Right!
I've been itchin' to cut loose myself."{w}
"Ha ha, now this is getting fun!"{w}
"But you were cutting loose just a minute ago."{w}
note: Refers to Zapper roughing Mirco up in practice (349-375).

en:
"You ain't even enough for a warm-up,
you worthless scuuuuum!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'scum', not softened.

en: "Uuu... that's so mean..."{w}
"Come on, let's go, Zephal!!"{w}

note: Self-intro wording per glossary note.

en: You routed Mirco and the others.{w}
note: Subject = the party ('you'), restored.

en: "Tch, so my sword has broken."{w}
"The swords you can pick up in this land are all junk, huh.{w}Want me to go grab you another one?"{w}

"No, that's quite all right."{w}{p}"At this point, I'll return to Belnaf
and fetch my usual sword.{w}This is getting us nowhere."{w}
"Huh!? Zephal, you're going home?"{w}

"What am I supposed to do if a strong enemy
shows up while you're gone, Zephal!?"{w}
"You have Zapper, don't you?{w}And besides, if it really comes to that...{w}couldn't you just defeat it yourself, Master Mirco?"{w}
"Huh?"{w}

"Master Mirco, you cannot keep
leaning on me forever.{w}What do you think that Baltagias is for?"{w}
